flow: Environment Ebola pathogen load (U)->Environment Ebola pathogen load (U)
param: α₂ Recruitment/inflow into infected humans (importation/recruitment of infected)
ψ₁ Effective contact/transmission coefficient from infected humans (P) to susceptible humans (A)
ψ₂ Effective contact/transmission coefficient from environmental pathogen load (U) to susceptible humans (A)
ψ₃ Effective contact/transmission coefficient from deceased humans (S) to susceptible humans (A) (e.g., unsafe burial contact)
ε Natural death/removal rate of humans (applies to A, P, F, K; also appears in death contributions to S)
ρ₁ Disease-induced death rate for infected humans (P)
ρ₂ Shedding/contamination rate from infected humans (P) to environment (U)
ρ₃ Quarantine/isolation rate of infected humans (P) into quarantined class (F)
ω₁ Recovery rate of quarantined humans (F) to recovered (K)
ω₂ Disease-induced death rate for quarantined humans (F)
h Contamination/shedding rate from deceased humans (S) to environment (U)
c Burial/removal rate of deceased humans (S) (safe burial/clearance)
b Environmental decay/clearance rate of Ebola pathogens from environment (U)
d External input/source term into environment (U) (e.g., bush meat/environmental introduction)
λ(A,P,S,U) Force of infection multiplier acting on susceptible humans (A)
δ_P Total removal rate from infected humans (P)
δ_F Total removal rate from quarantined humans (F)
δ_S Total removal rate from deceased humans (S) (to environment via h and burial via c)
